blocks.html: FRIDAY, JANUARY 22, 2016 – Robinsons Communities marked another significant chapter for one of its top-notch projects, Chimes Greenhills as construction goes full-swing with the first concrete pouring ceremony held recently. Attended by Ms. Mybelle V. Aragon-Gobio, Robinsons Land Corporation’s Senior Vice President for Robinsons Luxuria, Residences, Communities, and Right Homes; Mr. Pops Del Rosario, Operations Manager for Summit Hotels and Resorts; Robinsons Communities’ Department Heads, and key officials from the architectural and construction partners, the event signifies RLC’s commitment to deliver the project as scheduled to its future homeowners.

A high-rise residential development located along Annapolis Street, Chimes Greenhills is set to provide a lifestyle of comfort and convenience through the projects’ set of relaxing amenities and remarkable service facilities. The project is made more impressive with nearby commercial centers, premier medical and academic institutions and a Summit Hotel within the same development truly making it an affordable alternative to world-class living in a prominent Metro Manila address. To know more about Chimes Greenhills, you may visit Robinsons Communities official website www.robinsonscommunities.com or call 248-5888 and text 0932-700-0000.
